about: Answers that differ between ko_KR and en_US on the Node server. It is empty: sort order is pinned to 'en', and --ko-vs-en finds no difference in any of the 333 cases (recorded with --ko-vs-en --record-expected=<file>). An entry is one request (case, request id, path inside the answer); --ko-vs-en reports an entry as expected and fails when it no longer differs, so the list only shrinks.
